lines.en: An inch off the ground, I glide.
Chains clink at my waist.
I leave no prints and raise no dust.
Hover-thrusters carry me on.
My tall shadow sweeps the ground.
I go around the stones, not through.
Steady speed, straight line.

lines.zh: 前方的气流在我身边分开。
lines.en: The airflow parts around me.
I don't breathe, so I don't pant.
I drop low and slip into the treeline.

lines.zh: 身后只剩风推过的痕迹。
lines.en: Only the wind's disturbance remains.
Self-check: all nominal.
I stand like a wall.
My eye-light doesn't flicker.
I'm calculating this fight's odds.
My muscle never needs rest.
The metal at my joints is still warm.
There's an energy signature far off.

lines.zh: 等待指令，或者等一个破绽。
lines.en: Awaiting orders, or a weakness.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手指，关节无声。
lines.en: I flex a finger; the joint is silent.
My back is all hard plating.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，尘土落满肩。
lines.en: I stand still; dust settles on my shoulders.
There's only a blank in my memory.

lines.zh: 不需要呼吸的感觉很奇怪。
lines.en: Not needing to breathe feels strange.
How much force? All of it.
Identify: Saiyan? No.

lines.zh: 我看着你，同时算着距离。
lines.en: I watch you and measure the distance.
Your ki — pitifully faint.
My face shows nothing; don't guess.
No need to fear; I strike fast.
Your shadow behind you is long.
I'm watching your grip.
This body has no fatigue.
I lift my chin, inviting you.

lines.zh: 这片场地限制了我的翅膀？没有翅膀。
lines.en: No wings to limit me here.
Your heartbeat just quickened.
I know you'll strike first.
I'd rather finish this than talk.
Hull damage — negligible.
That knocked me slightly off line.
Joints grinding, but intact.
Pain? Not in my circuits.
You're wearing yourself down, not me.
Repair routine started.
I roll my head and continue.
A little white smoke from the wound.
That one goes in the combat log.
Do you carry an energy source?
That thing does nothing for me.
I need no supplies.
Trying to bait me?
Only combat interests me.
Stop waving that; it's a waste of time.

lines.zh: 我的能量不会自己流失。
lines.en: My energy doesn't drain on its own.
Bait doesn't work on me. Next.
You struck me — unwise.
My shoulder didn't give.
The impact was absorbed.
You slammed into casting metal.
Try again; it will be the same.

lines.zh: 我把身体往下一沉，稳住。
lines.en: I sink my weight and hold.
You rebound two steps.
Don't crowd me; I won't yield.
The contact point is heating up.
I raise a hand and brush you aside.
I don't have that function.
Breeding was not in the design.
Kin exchange data, nothing more.
Stand closer; let's sync coordinates.

lines.zh: 我们都是造出来的，不一样。
lines.en: We were both made, but not alike.
Our serial numbers sit close together.
Operating side by side is more efficient.
I'll watch your back.
A dull proposal, but accepted.
Body to body, with no warmth.
What is this? Logging it.
A piece of metal — of some use.
I pick it up and examine it.
You dropped this.
I crushed it in my hand.
No salvage value.
Hand it over? No.
Wrong weight — it's an alloy.
I put it back and move on.

lines.zh: 这枚零件的制造工艺很旧。
lines.en: This part's manufacturing is old.
Target locked. Engaging.
I've memorized your ki.
Twenty-three blocks — close enough.
I move first; try to keep up.
Combat mode engaged.
Your weakness is on your right.
I won't warn you.
This won't take long.
Airborne — taking the high ground.
You can't run; I see you.
I've raised the output.
ID confirmed. Mission begins.
Your breathing rhythm broke.
Don't expect any bargaining.
My calculations contain no failure.
Now. Move immediately.
Look up; I'm above you.
Dive angle adjusted.
You hide there; I go around.
Speed up one more notch.
I've seen that move before.
My fist waits mid-air for the moment.

lines.zh: 你在找我的破绽，很聪明。
lines.en: Looking for my opening — smart.
My path is a straight line.
Ki gathers in my palm.
Don't run to narrow places; I'm faster.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我多一分把握。
lines.en: Every step you retreat, I gain confidence.
I track only one target.
Your footsteps are coordinates.
I've calculated this strike's angle.
Your armor's gap is under the arm.
Two more blocks and I strike.
Air drag doesn't affect me.
I won't give you a breath.
A straight punch lands on your chest.
Three in a row, fixed rhythm.
My fist is harder than your bone.
Let's see how many you block.
Knee strike — from below.
You're driven back half a block.
That punch held nothing back.
A ki blast rides the palm.
I go for your footing.
The wind pressure behind my blows is heavy.
I drive you into the ground.
I turn and drive an elbow in.
I predicted that counter.
Final blow — finishing it.
Done, I step back half a pace.
The hatch opens and I step out.
Boot sequence complete.
Golden eyes light up.
This frame is heavier than expected.
I wake inside the cordon.
Dust in the air; I don't mind.
Calibration complete in three seconds.
I stand, taller than the door.
I've never seen terrain like this.
Mission parameters loaded.
I don't ask why.
The soil craters under my weight.
A low hum sounds on activation.
Something in the distance is watching.
I raise a hand and work the knuckles.
Confirm heading, then move.
This smell is new to me.
I wait for the first order.
Heat warning; my plating glows red.
I absorbed seventy percent of the impact.

lines.zh: 进水了，我拖着身体上浮。
lines.en: Water's inside; I haul myself up.
The blast shoved me off course.
Shrapnel lodged in my shoulder plate.
Anomalous energy is invading my circuits.
Power low; my movements slow.
Overload; my vision flickers.

lines.zh: 下面是无重力区，我在坠落。
lines.en: Zero gravity below; I'm falling.
